entries.wording: Canada多伦多总仓 已揽收
entries.english: Picked up by the Toronto main warehouse in Canada
entries.note: The first row, when the Toronto warehouse takes the parcel in.

entries.wording: 到达加拿大多伦多总仓
entries.english: Arrived at the Toronto main warehouse in Canada
entries.note: Written at the same minute as the pick-up.

entries.wording: 包裹已分拣出库，等待干线运输
entries.english: Sorted and out of the warehouse, waiting for the line haul
entries.note: Packed out of the Toronto warehouse for the flight to China.

entries.wording: 包裹已从国际干线运输启程离境
entries.english: Left the country on the international line haul
entries.note: The departure from Canada, the last row on Toronto's clock.

entries.english: Arrived in China, waiting for the customs transfer
entries.note: The arrival in China, held for the bonded transfer to the port where it is cleared. The first row on China's clock.

entries.wording: 已到达口岸，国际运输环节中，正在办理清关手续
entries.english: Arrived at the port, in international transit, being cleared through customs
entries.note: Customs clearance in China, before the hand-off to JD Logistics.
